content: Private Storage buckets should never be made public. Access is via supabase.storage.from(bucket).createSignedUrl(path, expirySeconds) generated server-side (Server Component, Route Handler, or Server Action) using a client with the user's session; the resulting time-limited URL is passed to the client for display/download. Storage also has its own RLS-style policies (storage.objects table) that should scope both read and write access to the owning user, in addition to the bucket being private, defense in depth.
